column2: This is HETMANATE I will write a description.
Attempt to become the Kozachina Hetman.
Might makes right! Prove your claim to the Hetmanate through force and take your rightful spot as the head of the Kozachina Host.
Reprivatizing this land will result in buildings being destroyed! Those currently living in those lands will not be happy.
The sovereign has recently reprivatized this Holding for farmland. The evicted inhabitants are arming themselves, hell-bent on reversing this decision.
Groups of nobles are reprivatizing the land of this county. If this county is conquered by a character who is not Noble Republic, the nobles will cease their activities.
This county has been reprivatized recently by nobles. For as long as this modifier remains, the county cannot be plundered or raided.
Reprivatization by nobles has left this land in a deopopulated state.
